entries.title: Stress practices and cell aging
entries.content: Some studies link meditation with markers of healthy cell aging, such as telomere length. This research is early.
entries.source: Meditation and Its Mental and Physical Health Benefits in 2023 - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Sleep and the aging brain
entries.content: Deep sleep helps the brain clear waste. Researchers are studying how long-term short sleep relates to memory as we age.
entries.source: The consequences of sleep deprivation on cognitive performance - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Mind-body and stress genes
entries.content: Early research suggests mind-body practices may change how some stress-related genes are switched on. More study is needed.
entries.source: Meditation and Its Mental and Physical Health Benefits in 2023 - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Green tea polyphenols
entries.content: Lab and population studies have looked at polyphenols in foods like green tea and memory. Results are mixed; enjoy them as part of a varied diet.
entries.source: The evidence for herbal and botanical remedies, Part 1
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only
